cards.observation: gas leak in a reported site

llmSuggestions: Evacuate non-essential personnel upwind to designated muster point and verify fixed detector loop telemetry with central control room.

Require positive pressure SCBA apparatus for entry and verify calibration certificates of gas detection instrumentation.

cards.title: Fluid/Oil on Walkways / Ground — Oil spill of approximately 200 ml observed near workshop entrance. Area cleaned immediately.
cards.description: Quote: "Oil spill of approximately 200 ml observed near workshop entrance" | Failed Barrier: Safety Barriers & Containment Spill Kit | Observation: Oil spill of approximately 200 ml observed near workshop entrance. Area cleaned immediately.
cards.observation: Oil spill of approximately 200 ml observed near workshop entrance. Area cleaned immediately.
cards.evidence_quote: Oil spill of approximately 200 ml observed near workshop entrance
llmSuggestions: Issue immediate Stop Work Authority to halt unsafe operational conditions and clear personnel from line of fire.
Perform physical barrier audit to re-establish primary and secondary defense layers according to IOGP safety protocols.

cards.title: Lifting & Mechanical Rigging Failure (Dropped Load) — During BOP stack installation on Moran Rig-04, the primary winch cable displayed severe wire strand fraying and unlatched secondary safety hook.
cards.description: Quote: "primary winch cable displayed severe wire strand fraying and unlatched secondary safety hook" | Failed Barrier: Certified Lifting Slings & Drop Zone Exclusion Barricade | Observation: During BOP stack installation on Moran Rig-04, the primary winch cable displayed severe wire strand fraying and unlatched secondary safety hook.
cards.observation: During BOP stack installation on Moran Rig-04, the primary winch cable displayed severe wire strand fraying and unlatched secondary safety hook.
cards.failed_barrier: Certified Lifting Slings & Drop Zone Exclusion Barricade
cards.evidence_quote: primary winch cable displayed severe wire strand fraying and unlatched secondary safety hook
llmSuggestions: Immediately ground suspended load and barricade 1.5x crane swing drop-zone with high-visibility safety tape.
Perform thorough visual inspection on wire rope slings, shackles, and load hooks for elongation, kinks, or missing safety latches.
Re-verify Critical Lift Plan calculation sheet and ensure banksman / rigger certification is current before any further lift.
cards.possible_consequence: Massive crush trauma from dropped heavy suspended load or catastrophic rigging collapse

cards.description: Quote: "carabiner gate unlatched during casing running at 28m" | Failed Barrier: 100% Tie-Off Full Body Fall Arrest System | Observation: Derrickman observed working on monkey board at 28m height without positive double-action locking carabiner engaged.

cards.title: Digboi Field Station Substation Earth Pit High Resistance — Earth pit EP-04 measured 18.4 Ohms against maximum allowable 1.0 Ohm.
cards.description: Quote: "earth pit measured 18.4 Ohms vs 1.0 Ohm limit" | Failed Barrier: Hazardous Area Electrical Bonding & Static Earthing | Observation: Dried bentonite compound and broken copper tape bond discovered during pre-monsoon electrical audit.
cards.observation: Dried bentonite compound and broken copper tape bond discovered during pre-monsoon electrical audit at beam pump electrical panel.
cards.hazard: Arc Flash & Static Spark in Hydrocarbon Zone
cards.failed_barrier: Hazardous Area Electrical Bonding & Static Earthing
cards.evidence_quote: earth pit measured 18.4 Ohms vs 1.0 Ohm limit
llmSuggestions: Treat earth pit with conductive carbon backfill and water rehydration salts immediately.
Install new 25x3mm copper earth bus link with cadweld fusion joints.
Re-measure earth impedance to guarantee < 1.0 Ohm under full load.
cards.possible_consequence: Hydrocarbon flash fire, catastrophic vapor cloud explosion (VCE), or severe third-degree thermal burns

cards.title: Kumchai Gas Field Manifold Flange Bolt Torquing Deficiency — Missing 2 studs on high pressure gas choke manifold rated 5,000 psi.
